home.title: Radici San Giovanni Lipioni
home.intro: A digital guide to explore the village with an interactive map, slow itineraries, local stories and a chatbot based on place sheets.
home.whyText: The project starts from a family and cultural bond with the village, arranging places, memories and expandable information without inventing local history.
home.placesText: Selected places with descriptive sheets, real images and map links.
home.itinerariesText: Short routes for slow tourism and respectful visits.
home.storiesText: Stories and memories arranged to connect places, families and landscape.
home.rootsText: The app organises places, text, images and routes in a structure ready to grow with new sheets, photos and chatbot features.
home.finalCtaText: Explore the mapped points and open the chatbot whenever you want to ask about available content.

stories.title: Stories, memory and roots
stories.intro: A demo collection about return visits, everyday places and family ties. The texts are not real testimonies.

privacy.title: Privacy and Cookies
privacy.intro: This page explains simply how the project works. The text must be validated by a legal consultant before final publication.
sections: Data controller: independent cultural project Radici di San Giovanni Lipioni. Privacy contact and registered office: Information to verify.
Radici di San Giovanni Lipioni is an independent cultural project and does not represent the Municipality of San Giovanni Lipioni.
The demo does not include accounts, public forms, payments or user uploads.
localStorage is used for selected language, cookie preferences and non-sensitive UI state.
Cookie preferences are stored in localStorage and can be reset by the user from the privacy page or footer.
AnalyticsService is mock: no real analytics script is loaded before explicit consent.
Necessary cookies are always active; analytics, marketing and preferences are disabled by default and editable by the user.
The map uses OpenStreetMap tiles loaded from external servers. The Google Maps button opens a new tab only after an explicit user action.
Instagram is not embedded in the site: social content remains separate editorial material.
Main geographic markers come from public OpenStreetMap sources; stories, editorial text, images and accessibility must be verified before real publication.

location.title: Where San Giovanni Lipioni Is Located
location.intro: San Giovanni Lipioni is in the Alto Vastese area, in the province of Chieti, Abruzzo. The coordinates identify the village centre and should be used as a general visit reference.

chatbot.title: Radici assistant
chatbot.intro: Answers using the guide’s places, itineraries and content.
chatbot.placeholder: Write a question about the village...
chatbot.welcome: Hello, I’m the Radici assistant. I can help you discover places in San Giovanni Lipioni, choose a route and open stops on the map. Try one of the suggestions below or ask me anything.
chatbot.fallback: I can’t find that information in this guide. Ask me what to see in the centre, about a place, or for an itinerary. For opening hours, services and current conditions, check with local sources.
chatbot.openRelatedPlace: Open linked place on the map
quickPrompts: What should I see in the centre?
Are there parking or opening hours?

cookie.title: Cookie preferences

cookie.necessaryText: Always active for security, language and basic preferences.

cookie.marketingText: Not used in the demo, disabled by default.
cookie.preferencesText: Stores non-sensitive choices such as language and UI settings.
